mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a pleasant 66 degrees with clear skies at the Military Ridge State Trail, and we are currently seeing a First Quarter moon.
The city is currently working on the Mark Drive reconstruction project, which includes updating water and sewer services along with adding new sidewalks to improve neighborhood connectivity.

We have a busy day ahead! Today you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, practice yoga at Insight Wellness, or head to trivia night at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, look forward to Concerts in the Park and trivia at Hop Haus.
In a notable incident from this past Friday, officers arrested a 44-year-old woman for an O W I after she was found unresponsive behind the wheel of her vehicle.

Today's delicious flavor is Double Strawberry. Culver's is currently closed but will open at 10 AM. Since there are no Kona Ice stops in Verona today, just head to Culver's tomorrow to try the Chocolate Heath Crunch.
